q: I stayed late three nights last week but never put anything in beforehand. Will that reach my pay?
log:
This confirms the picture. Let me check the HR desk exception process briefly for completeness.

READ overtime-overview

I have enough to answer confidently now.

DONE

Based on what I found: No, those three late nights will not reach your pay as overtime. Overtime only becomes paid overtime through a request — submitted and approved *before* the hours are worked (or, at the latest, filed within 3 working days afterward with manager approval noting the delay). Since nothing was filed beforehand or within that window, the hours will simply be logged as ordinary attendance, not overtime. The system/HR does not backfill a request after the fact, and even a manager verbally saying "go ahead and stay" doesn't count as a request. Your only recourse now is to raise it as an exception with the HR desk — but that approval is not routine, so it's not guaranteed.
